name: context-262k
about: Can the server run at the model's native 262,144-token context: does a ~200k-token agent request fit in memory without swapping, generate at a usable speed, and still end in a valid tool call? (Whether fewer compactions reduce regressions needs a full run.)
server_note: start the server with CTX=262144 (harness: BENCH_CONTEXT=262144)

criteria.name: the long request is accepted and answered
it really was a long context (at least 190k prompt tokens)
generation stays usable at that depth (at least 20 tok/s)
the reply still ends in a valid tool call
